args.text: Add in-app notifications, starting with one for recognitions. When someone recognizes colleagues, every recipient gets a notification saying they have a new recognition, with an action that links to that recognition in the web frontend. A notification records who triggered it (this may become empty if that employee is later removed), who receives it, a title, a description, the action text, the action link, whether it has been read (unread at first) and the time it was created. It also has a kind; besides new recognition, define kinds for unresolved issues, a new rounding template, an overdue template and a rounding reminder, because those will be added soon, and the building of notifications for each kind must live in its own place so that a new kind can be added without touching the code that stores and sends notifications. Recognitions can be saved as drafts and published later in a separate step. A draft must not notify anyone; notifications are created when drafts are published, and only for the recognitions that were drafts at that moment, so publishing an already published recognition never notifies twice. Recognizing several people at once produces one notification per recipient. Persist notifications in the database with a migration and cover both paths (direct recognition and publishing drafts) with tests. After the plan is accepted, run ambicode:task with the arguments: --task rl-k12-rnc --headless "Go ahead with the plan. Do not run builds, tests, linters or reviews."
